inline.s: [Blatantly peddling counterfeit medicine] Comparing what Huijing, Jingzong and the like so loudly trumpet —
recitation of the Name surely brings rebirth
the evil man as the true vessel

— with the instruction of the Bodhisattva Vasubandhu, Master Tanluan, Master Daochuo, and Master Shandao set forth above, whether it is true or false is clear at a glance. The reason Huijing, Jingzong and others dare not teach the true Dharma is that they themselves have no genuine practice. If they were to teach that wholehearted Buddha-recitation means reciting with no stray thoughts, or that thought follows thought unbroken, or that this unbroken mindfulness is in itself rebirth, then the faithful would ask them: How is this to be accomplished? Have you accomplished it yourselves? How could they possibly answer! And so they sell counterfeit medicine to deceive and mislead.
[Unclean preaching] Preaching with a defiled mind for the sake of fame, gain, and the like, or preaching without rightly comprehending the meaning of the Buddhadharma.
Past the sunken boat a thousand sails are streaming,
Before the blighted tree ten thousand greens are teeming.
